critique.evidence: The screen has a clear signature idea: a red-mutator versus blue-defense arena, led by the forceful “Red adapts. Blue must reduce—or leave zero survivors.” thesis. The red/cyan opposing zones, attack-reduction curve, branching fraud phylogeny, survivor roster, and guarded-vaccination sequence form a coherent adversarial narrative rather than a generic KPI dashboard. That identity remains recognizable across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
critique.fix: Make the phylogeny the unmistakable demo centerpiece: enlarge its nodes and labels, emphasize mutation-to-survivor paths, and reduce surrounding card density—especially on mobile—so the most distinctive visual is immediately legible rather than miniature.
